text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Leader of legal Islamist party Hamas, Sheikh Mahfoud Nahnah explains why party is not willing to change its name as demanded by the interior ministry under the new election law. Nahnah said his position on participation in the elections will be made in light of contacts with the ministry.
- President Liamine Zeroual shows inflexible resolution to have the law respected over the June 5 parliamentary elections.

- All wilayas (provinces) in Algeria will have right to a watchdog commission for the parliamentary elections. These commissions, immediately after being installed, will have to set up other bodies at the level of communes so that "for the first time the people themselves are going to control the elections".
- Political parties focus their immediate concern on drawing up lists of candidates for the elections.
